social_circle.name: Lucia Rivas

demographics.occupation: Full-time caregiver; previously service and care-related work

background.how_they_met: Lucia is Omar's mother and has cared for him since birth.
background.why_close: She is his primary daily caregiver, feeds him, handles naps and appointments, and is usually the person who calms him fastest.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts mostly in Spanish or bilingual Spanish-English, often with full sentences, baby photos, quick check-ins, and occasional voice notes when tired or busy.

recent_text_topics: Updates about Omar's feeding, naps, diapers, and longer awake periods.
Questions to Mateo or Elena about whether Omar seems tired, overstimulated, or ready for quiet time.
Private baby photos and short videos sent to relatives on WhatsApp.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q01 says Lucia is answering for Omar and spends the most time with him. Q11 says Lucia handles most daytime baby care, meals, laundry, and appointments. Q44 says Lucia calmed Omar by taking him to a quiet bedroom and singing softly in Spanish.

social_circle.name: Mateo Rivas

background.how_they_met: Mateo is Omar's father and has been part of his life since birth.
background.why_close: Mateo is the main earner and evening caregiver, carrying Omar after work, helping with baths, and connecting him to ranch sounds and outdoor routines.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short practical texts, often from work breaks; uses simple Spanish-English phrasing, quick photos, and brief voice messages when hands are busy.

shared_activities: listening to quieter Johnny Cash songs
short outdoor moments hearing wind and animals
recent_text_topics: Checking whether Omar slept well after Mateo's early work starts.
Coordinating clinic rides, grocery stops, diapers, and gas money.
Sharing small milestones, like Omar reaching for toys or calming when Mateo hums.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Mateo carries Omar in the evening and sometimes takes him outside to hear wind and animals. Q11 says Mateo helps with baths, carrying Omar, and household repairs. Q106-Q107 describe Mateo's cattle, ranch, or feedlot work.

social_circle.name: Elena Rivas

background.how_they_met: Elena is Omar's grandmother and became closely involved after his birth.
background.why_close: She visits often, helps Lucia with laundry and cooking, gives informal baby-care advice, and sings old songs that fit the family's Spanish-speaking traditions.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Warm Spanish texts with affectionate nicknames, practical reminders, prayer language, and voice notes instead of long typing.

shared_activities: helping with laundry or cooking while Omar rests
occasional late visits or naps at the household
recent_text_topics: Asking how Omar slept and whether Lucia needs rest.
Offering to bring food, diapers, or help with laundry.
Reminding the family to keep Omar's nap time protected during gatherings.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Elena sings old songs and helps with laundry or cooking. Q13 says Elena may stay late or nap there but does not live there. Q35 says Elena helps when Lucia needs rest.

social_circle.name: Rosa Delgado

background.how_they_met: Rosa is a neighbor in Omar's close-knit Hereford community and became connected to the family through proximity and repeated practical help.
background.why_close: She sometimes brings food, briefly holds Omar while Lucia gets something done, and respects the family's need for quiet, trusted care.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Friendly bilingual texts, often short and practical; likely sends quick 'necesitas algo?' check-ins and uses a few heart or prayer emojis.

shared_activities: holding Omar briefly while Lucia completes chores
recent_text_topics: Offering leftovers or a simple meal when the household is tired.
Checking whether Lucia needs anything from the store.
Asking how Omar is doing after noisy gatherings or rough sleep nights.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 explicitly names neighbor Rosa as someone who sometimes brings food and may hold Omar briefly while Lucia gets something done. Q08 says people in the neighborhood know each other through work, school, relatives, or church.

social_circle.name: Marisol Garza

demographics.education: Secondary school with some vocational training

background.how_they_met: Marisol is an inferred maternal aunt or close aunt-like relative in Monterrey, part of the extended family network that follows Omar through WhatsApp photos and video calls.
background.why_close: The family considered moving closer to relatives in Monterrey, and WhatsApp keeps those relatives emotionally present in Omar's life despite distance.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses WhatsApp heavily, sends voice notes, affectionate Spanish messages, emojis, and frequent requests for photos or short videos.

shared_activities: talking about possible visits between Texas and Monterrey
recent_text_topics: Requesting new photos and videos of Omar reaching for toys or smiling.
Talking with Lucia about whether the family might visit Monterrey later.
Commenting on Omar's Spanish lullabies, feeding changes, and early soft-food tastes.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q02 says Omar's parents discussed moving closer to relatives in Monterrey but chose to stay in Hereford. Q48 says WhatsApp is used for photos and video calls with relatives in Monterrey. Q86 confirms Omar has relatives in Mexico, including Monterrey.
